ai_agent_workflows.workflow_name: Create an executive memo from the book
ai_agent_workflows.goal: Produce a concise source-grounded memo for one executive decision.
preconditions: company facts separated from source ideas
inspection_steps: Select up to five source records.
Summarize source thesis in one paragraph.
Translate to operating implications and tradeoffs.
List evidence needed and verification flags.
questions_to_ask: What decision will the memo inform?
Which QCDS dimension is most relevant?
Which facts are company-provided versus source-derived?
